name: bc-report-layout-preview
description: Render a Business Central report to PDF with the layout in your workspace and compare it side by side with the layouts already published in the environment.

commands.title: BC Layout Preview: Compare Layout with Environment
BC Layout Preview: Re-run Last Comparison
BC Layout Preview: Reset Saved Environment Settings
BC Layout Preview: Install or Update Helper App

bcLayoutPreview.ignoreCertificateErrors.description: Accept self-signed or otherwise untrusted TLS certificates when talking to an on-premises Business Central server. Only enable this for servers you trust.

bcLayoutPreview.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a single render before giving up. Large reports over many records can take minutes.

bcLayoutPreview.saas.clientId.description: Entra application (client) id used for Business Central SaaS. Leave empty to sign in with the Microsoft account already used by VS Code.

bcLayoutPreview.saas.clientSecret.description: Client secret for the Entra application. Only needed for service-to-service authentication; prefer leaving this empty and signing in interactively.

bcLayoutPreview.helper.appName.markdownDescription: Name of the helper app to look for in the environment. Matched on the app name alone — publisher and version are ignored, so any build of the app is recognised. Leave empty to use the name from the bundled app's `app.json`.

bcLayoutPreview.helper.apiPublisher.markdownDescription: The `APIPublisher` segment of the helper's API URL. Leave empty to use the value read from the bundled app's API page.

bcLayoutPreview.helper.apiGroup.markdownDescription: The `APIGroup` segment of the helper's API URL. Leave empty to use the value read from the bundled app's API page.

bcLayoutPreview.helper.apiVersion.markdownDescription: The `APIVersion` segment of the helper's API URL. Leave empty to use the value read from the bundled app's API page.

bcLayoutPreview.autoInstallHelper.description: Publish the helper app automatically the first time an environment is used. When disabled, run 'Install or Update Helper App' by hand.
